breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) on the same boundaries. The agent correctly identified this conflict and removed the incorrect Dirichlet condition, specifying only the Neumann conditions, which aligns with the ground truth.
